notes:
Lead came from blog post about summarization + tool calling. Small engineering org (mobile + backend team). Primary ask: automatically summarize incoming support emails into structured ticket fields (summary, urgency, customer_impact, suggested_tags) and call internal webhook to update ticket system. Interested in hosted API because fast time-to-value and no infra ops.

Key requirements (from discovery):
- Latency: p95 < 300ms for single-turn summarization (real-time triage).
- Throughput: avg 2-8 requests/sec, spikes to ~20 during day.
- Cost sensitivity: high — wants guidance on batching + caching.
- Model preferences: open-models ok; prefer cost-effective 7B/13B family or quantized variants.
- Routing/fallback: simple fallback to smaller model if host limits reached.
- Security: SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs for API usage, optional KMS integration if they migrate to Private later.

Quotes from call: "We need something that just works out of the box — engineers can't babysit another infra stack." — Head of Product.

Current stance: leaning Hosted API, will run 2-week POC (10k messages/month) to validate quality + costs. Wants sample prompt set and cost projection before committing to POC.

Open items for AE/SE:
- Provide usage-based cost model with batching scenarios (per-ticket cost at 1, 5, 20 token batch).
- Share 2 example structured-output templates and tool-calling webhook sample.
- Confirm timeline for enabling SSO in hosted console (they want within 6 weeks).

Stubs/links: Fireflies FF-20987 (transcript), pricing notes in Drive, Gmail thread gthr-98234. Jira REDW-4120 logged for SE follow-up on sample payloads.
